description:
The timeline preview plays the CURRENT clip's original audio through
EditorAudioPlayback — the editor's transport verbatim, adapted to the
timeline's plan-driven position math. The video loop stays the
master; audio follows with its own device clock and never gates it.

Gates (the editor's honesty rules):
- AUD-02: audio plays ONLY when the source's link state is ATTACHED
  (AudioStore lookup). DETACHED, REMOVED and LINKED_EDITED stay
  silent; LINKED_EDITED's edited recording is not played here.
- AUD-06: the position maps through the SOURCE's own measured fps,
  never the project's (the two disagree the moment a 24 fps source
  sits in a 30 fps project) and never an assumed rate — a null or
  non-positive rate pauses: silence, never a guess.
- The start requires the current session to be the clip's source;
  audio begins only when the video session it rides is open.
